review.method: Independent visual review of Poppler-rendered source pages, cross-checked with pdftotext -layout and the authored schedule row labels.
review.reason: The frozen compile keys predate coverage of visibly authored air-device and expansion-tank schedule rows. These additive corrections preserve the original files and change only independently reviewed omissions.

evidence: GRILLE, REGISTER, AND DIFFUSER SCHEDULE has 23 authored rows: 12 supply, 8 return, and 3 exhaust devices.
EXPANSION TANK SCHEDULE has two authored equipment rows, ET-1 and ET-2.
DIFFUSER SCHEDULE has seven authored rows, D-1 through D-7.
RETURN & EXHAUST GRILLE SCHEDULE has four authored rows, R-1 through R-4.

review.method: Visual review of the rendered schedules (PyMuPDF crops of the printed tables), cross-checked with the sheet graph's extracted rows. The frozen key predates the mark rules that read the split system's rows (AS-63) and the reading of a schedule whose units run across its columns (AS-65).

evidence: SPLIT SYSTEM AIR CONDITIONING UNIT SCHEDULE has one authored row, SYMBOL SS-1/SSCU-1 (service IT ROOM, 24 MBH cooling, R-410A): the split system's indoor unit SS-1 and its outdoor condensing unit SSCU-1.

AIR HANDLING UNIT SCHEDULE prints its one unit across its column: SYMBOL AHU-15, SERVICE NEW SPS (the sterile processing service the project expands), supply fan 26,000 CFM (21,500 connected) at 3.00 in. ESP, outside air 26,000 CFM design and 21,500 minimum, 480-3, VENTROL CUSTOM. The key's note (UH/FAN/PUMP/GRD/louver + PRV) lists the schedules read before a transposed schedule was read (AS-65).
